Subject: Follow-up: deployment needs & PHI handling

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — really helpful to see the latency numbers and the model fallbacks. A couple of follow-ups from our security and infra teams:

- We need PHI controls and strict data residency in the EU for any production path.
- Target sustained throughput: ~20 requests/sec for inference of medium-sized contexts (2k tokens).
- P95 inference latency target: ideally <180ms.
- Procurement will want to see SOC 2 evidence and an outline of where logs/audit trails live.

We are considering whether to start the PoC on Dedicated capacity (faster to stand up) vs request a Private VPC pilot (preferred from security but may add lead time). Can you propose a short PoC plan (success criteria, timeline, stakeholders) for both paths so we can evaluate?

I've attached our security questionnaire (HealthStack_security_questions.xlsx) for reference.

Also looping in our procurement lead if needed once we have a recommended approach.

Best,
Emma

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear asks and for the questionnaire. Quick summary below and a recommended PoC path with owners so you have something concrete to review with procurement/security.

High-level deployment options (pros/cons):
- Hosted API: fastest time-to-value but not suitable for PHI or strict EU residency.
- Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput, can be isolated to a customer GPU pool; lower lead time and good for controlled rollouts.
- Private VPC / on-prem: full network isolation and data residency controls, best for PHI workloads but longer setup (VPC peering, KMS integration, audit configuration).

Our recommendation for HealthStack: start PoC on Dedicated capacity to validate integration and performance (shorter ramp), with a parallel plan to validate Private VPC for production transition if your security team requires it. We can compress the Private onboarding steps into a follow-up sprint if you want to prioritize it.

Proposed PoC plan (5–6 weeks):
1) Discovery & access (1 week)
   - Confirm datasets, EU region endpoints, and procurement contacts.
   - Deliverables: PoC scope doc, access checklist.
2) Integration & small-scale verification (2 weeks)
   - SDK integration, schema/IO checks, prompt templates.
   - Owner: Laura Bennett.
3) Load testing & latency tuning (1 week)
   - Ramp to target 20 req/s with KV cache config and batching profiles.
   - Owner: Karthik Iyer (infra/load tests).
4) Security validation & governance checks (1 week)
   - SOC2 evidence, audit log review, KMS policies.
   - Owner: Marcus Lin (CS & compliance coordination).
5) Evaluation & decision (1 week)
   - Run success criteria checks and handoff checklist for production path.

Success criteria (pass/fail):
- Functional: SDK requests and responses for 95% of test prompts without format regressions.
- Performance: Sustain 20 req/s with median latency <120ms and P95 <180ms under PoC load.
- Security/compliance: Evidence of log retention, KMS integration, and a SOC2 summary acceptable to your procurement team.
- Ops: Autoscaling behavior validated (no dropped requests during 2x traffic spike).

Preliminary timing: total 5–6 weeks from kickoff if we start on Dedicated this week; add 2–3 weeks for Private VPC onboarding (networking/KMS/DNS) in parallel or after initial validation.

Next steps we propose:
- Quick kickoff call this week to lock scope and procurement contact (30 min).
- We'll send the PoC template and our Private VPC checklist (see attachments) and an initial Dedicated cost band.

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_PoC_template.xlsx, private-vpc-checklist.md, SOC2_summary.pdf

If this aligns, I can schedule the kickoff and assign owners in a follow-up invite.

Best,
Neha Kapoor

Thanks — that readout is exactly what I needed. A couple of clarifications:

- Procurement & compliance lead is Oliver Park (oliver.park@healthstack.io) — looping him on this thread.
- We absolutely need EU data residency for production. For PoC, Dedicated in an EU region is acceptable as long as we can show the data flow and logs stay in-region.

We are leaning toward starting the PoC on Dedicated to move faster, but we want the Private VPC checklist and a target calendar for the Private rollout post-PoC. Can you include a rough Dedicated cost band (monthly baseline) and estimated lead time to enable Private VPC when you send the PoC template?

Oliver, happy to sync if you want to jump on the kickoff.

—Emma
